_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: AQA A-level Accounting (7127) specification: subject content sections 3.1-3.18 and the annex quantitative skills in accounting
_items_source.version: Version 1.0 (22 December 2016), for teaching from September 2017 onwards - the current version linked from aqa.org.uk/7127, itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: AQA numbers the A-level content only to section level (3.1-3.18); it has no official numbering below that. This course adds its own sub-lettering (e.g. 3.3a, 3.3b) at the deepest examinable point within each section, in the order AQA's specification text presents them. The nine quantitative skills in the annex are unnumbered bullets; this course numbers them QS1-QS9 in AQA's own order.
